items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: All I can remember was, when Mr. Pena, he used to play drums and I didn't pay too much to the other people who was playing there.

ctx.x: Or Pete Lawless, I guess. I used to go there every night.

See, they had their own band there. All I can remember was, when Mr. Pena, he used to play drums and I didn't pay too much to the other people who was playing there. I used to go there every night and we'd knock off it, sit and stop by there, see what was going on.

When you were young, who were the best trombonists around town in the early days that you can remember? Hearing music? When did you move here? You didn't hear music much before you left town, I guess, here to go up to… How old were you when you went to Napoleonville? Oh, I was a baby.
